Claim 26 (currently amended): (Currently Amended)A non-aqueous composition comprising: a therapeutically effective amount of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID), said NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in a non-aqueous carrier wherein the non-aqueous carrier comprises a bio-compatible oil and from 20 wt.% to 80 wt.% phosphatidylcholine; the NSAID to non-aqueous carrier weight ratio is about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin oil.

Claim 33 (previously presented): (Previously Submitted)The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin oil.

Claim 35 (previously presented): (Previously Submitted)The non-aqueous composition according to claim 26, wherein the bio-compatible oil is a lecithin oil.

Claim 50 (currently amended): (Currently Amended)A non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition comprising a biocompatible oil carrier including phosphatidylcholine and salicylate NSAID, said salicylate NSAID being admixed as a powder directly in the biocompatible oil carrier, said composition having a weight ratio of salicylate NSAID to biocompatible oil of about 5:1 to about 1:5, wherein the biocompatible oil is a lecithin oil.

Claim 51 (currently amended): (Currently Amended)The non-aqueous pharmaceutical composition of claim 50 comprising from 10 wt % to 60 wt% phosphatidylcholine.
